title: Reduction isomorphism of coefficient lift
statement: For every commutative ring A, ideal I, square Jacobian presentation P of an A/I-algebra B as in [lem-exc-etale-jacobian-presentation], and chosen coefficient lift L of [def-exc-etale-algebra-lift], the quotient of L.LiftRing by I extended along A to L.LiftRing is ring-isomorphic to B by an isomorphism e satisfying e(mk x) = L.reduction x for every x.

proof.text: Let J be I extended to L.LiftRing, Q = L.LiftRing/J, and q the composite polynomial quotient map. Constants from I vanish in Q, so the coefficient map descends to c : A/I to Q. Evaluate the old variables at q(X_some_i) to obtain g. Polynomial extensionality gives g(map(mk_I)(p)) = q(rename_some(p)). The equations map_relation show that g kills every original relation; the presentation kernel is their span, so the quotient equivalence of the presentation gives a ring homomorphism h : B to Q with h(aeval(P.val)(p)) = g(p).

The reduction map kills J because it sends each coefficient a in I through A/I. Descend it to f : Q to B. On coefficients and the old variables f composed with g is aeval(P.val). Surjectivity of this presentation evaluation then proves f(h(b)) = b for every b.

Apply pderiv_map, map_relation and RingHom.map_det to the lifted Jacobian polynomial. The reduced matrix is the transpose of P.jacobiMatrix by map_eq_id; det_transpose removes this transpose. Thus h(P.jacobian) = q(rename_some(L.jacobianPolynomial)). The lifted equation t times Delta minus 1 vanishes in Q, giving q(X_none) times h(P.jacobian) = 1. Since h(P.jacobian) is a unit, cancellation proves h(P.jacobian_isUnit.unit inverse) = q(X_none).

The composite h with polynomialReduction agrees with q on coefficients, old variables, and the extra variable none by the preceding inverse-Jacobian calculation. MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext proves the equality on every polynomial. Surjectivity of each quotient map then gives h(f(x)) = x for all x in Q. Assemble f and h with these two inverse laws into the required RingEquiv; its action on mk(x) is reduction(x) by definition.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientLift_reduction_equiv {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra (A ⧸ I) B] {m : ℕ} (P : Algebra.SquareJacobianPresentation (A ⧸ I) B (Fin m)) (L : Algebra.SquareJacobianPresentation.CoefficientLift I P) : ∃ e : (L.LiftRing ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A L.LiftRing)) ≃+* B, ∀ x : L.LiftRing, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A L.LiftRing)) x) = L.reduction x
